“Yes. It is a seal. So long as it remains wrapped around the arm, the Magic Circuits within it will not manifest. Even when you employ magecraft, the left arm will be treated as something separate from you.

“But do not grow complacent. Magical energy passes through the living body even when no magecraft is being used. Each time it does, the arm will hurt, and there will be a backlash as it tries to activate.

“To prevent that, I wrapped the arm in the Shroud of Martin, a holy burial cloth that kills magical energy. So long as it remains in place, it should restrain the arm's invasion to some degree.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Yes, it is a seal. The Magic Circuit in your left arm will not be activated as long as you keep it on. Your arm is treated as a different object even if you use magic.
But do not let your guard down. Magical energy flows through your body even if you do not use any magic. Pain will assail your arm as it reacts and tries to activate.
Your left arm is covered with the Shroud of Martin to prevent that.
It should be able to suppress the infringement from your left arm to a certain extent as long as you keep it on.”

If you want to live to old age, become a great enough magus to match the arm. You should then be able to seal your arm without the shroud.”

pages.mirrorMoon: “I estimate it will be about ten years before the arm consumes you. You have that much time. You can become a master magus and control your arm, or you can fail and be consumed. It is not an imminent threat.”

“………………”

Hardly urgent? I have been altered without my knowledge.

…But complaining will change nothing.

I should have died in that forest.

Transplanting Archer's arm was how they saved me. To object now would be to throw away the life I was given back.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“……”
This is like I was remodeled without my knowing.
…But it’s no use complaining.
I would’ve died in that forest.
Transplanting Archer’s arm was the only way to save my life, so complaining would mean I don’t want to live.

“I suppose I do not need to worry if you can talk like that. Then go outside. Rin is waiting for you in the chapel.”

“—Thank you for the advice. But I'm not withdrawing.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Right. That is why there is no reason to fight. Any more battle is meaningless. You would be wise to stay in your mansion and wait until the war is over.”
“Thanks for the warning. But I’m not going to forfeit.”

She looks away.

Sakura cannot be saved if Zouken wins.

And so Tohsaka is saying that if someone must win, it will be either Sakura or herself.

That alone is why she will fight Zouken Matou.

Though she can no longer obtain the Holy Grail, Tohsaka does, beneath all her protests, want to save Sakura—her younger sister.
